title: 第208章 灵心佛子笑金刚佛子动第206章 诸位请随我一起极乐吧
content_zh:
佛门之中，派系可不少，每一个派系代表着各自的利益，外人，终究是很难进入核心，哪怕你付出再多，做得再好，始终无法进入核心，天生注定的，无法改变。
和你的天赋实力没关系，单纯是因为你这个人不是他们的人，凡是后面加入的，都不可能接触到核心，排外非常严重，佛门之中，彼此的关系也不一样，比如金刚佛子和莲华菩萨的地位不一样，比起清明菩萨的地位不知道高了多少，哪怕清明菩萨的辈分比较高，实力也强一点，照样无法进入核心。
她的地位十分尴尬，干活，做事，什么都是她，结果呢，好处轮不到她，所作所为，都成为了他人的嫁衣，给他人增加功劳，而自己呢，什么都没得到。
十分残酷的现实，让她想要逃离他们，逃离金刚佛子和须弥佛祖，只是，以前她无处可逃，仁慈佛祖那边，不可能接纳她，就算接纳了，也是把她当做局外人，随便应付，或者说，只想要让她干活，什么好处都不给，照样进入不了核心。
那样的话，随时都可能被抛弃，还不如继续留下来，以前的黄眉佛祖也是一样，甚至于，更加狠辣，对待自己人也能下狠手，唯独……这一次不一样，眼前的黄眉佛祖不是黄眉佛祖，而是灵心佛子。
二者是不一样，虽说灵心佛子取代了黄眉佛祖的一切，以他的身份行事，可清明菩萨还是能够看出来此人的不一样，灵心佛子是可以投靠的，而且，对待她也非常好，看着手心里的丹药，还有灵心佛子对她的态度，无不证明了灵心佛子更值得追随。
清明菩萨拿到了许多好处离开，这些好处可都是须弥佛祖给不了的，是她这么多年都没见过的，清明菩萨能不心动吗？能不感动吗？
灵心佛子目送她离去，笑容满面：“金刚佛子，须弥佛祖，你们连自己的人都看不住，都受不住，凭什么和我斗？”
“清明菩萨这么重要的人才，你们竟然随手舍弃，呵呵呵。”
“反而看重那些废物，废物就是废物，无论怎么培养，无论投入再多的资源，结果还是一样，无法改变。”
“清明菩萨此人非常聪明，也非常出色，她所缺乏的是一个机会，一些资源罢了，这些，我都可以给她，就看她怎么做了？”
自己给的好处很多，诚意也满满，清明菩萨跟了他，可以……得到更多的机会，也可以进入核心，灵心佛子会把她当做是核心培养，也让她进入核心，这就是她的诚意。
是其他人给不了的，也是因为灵心佛子手里缺人，之前的那些人，被黄眉佛祖祸害得七七八八，他需要重新召回这些人，重新培养一批自己的人，别人的人，终究是别人的。
唯有自己的人，才最可信。
“佛门动乱开始了，就从清明菩萨开始。”
“希望那些人能够活得久一点，不要那么快死去。”
“多给金刚佛子他们造成多一困难，最好，杀死他身边一批人，让他损失惨重。”
灵心佛子双眸闪烁光芒，佛光收敛，他盯着外面，不出去，不阻拦，也不参与。
就是当一个局外人，盯着这一切。
另一边，金刚佛子可就惨了。

好不容易追上了敌人，却发现……被戏耍了，原地留下了一道黑气，什么都没有。
那一道黑气在他们来到的时候，碰撞的瞬间，直接爆炸，可怜的金刚佛子被黑气笼罩，身后的其他人反应不及，跟着被黑气所笼罩，这一切，发生得太快了。
他们无法躲避，也来不及闪开，一个个被黑气笼罩，然后，他们站在原地，一个两个脸色变得难看，黑气包裹，多少人会被黑气侵蚀，到最后，是否会成为敌人？
在场这些人沉默了，因为他们害怕金刚佛子转手对付他们，他们很清楚沾染了黑气的下场，宁可杀错，也不会放过他们。
金刚佛子握紧拳头，一身青筋暴露，死死盯着眼前的黑气，散去的黑气，留下了一道痕迹，其他的，什么都没有留下，枯土尊者早就跑了，还给他留下了一份大礼。
这一次对峙，他失败了，失败得很彻底。
本以为找到了敌人，能够捉住他，然后找到黑莲本体所在，一并毁灭逃出来的黑莲本体，殊不知自己一切都在他人的掌控之中，枯土尊者在引诱他离开，故意为之。
另一边的佛门弟子，少了好几个，那些弟子的下场可想而知，金刚佛子收到了消息，那张脸越发阴沉难看，身边的人一个个不敢呼吸，大气不敢喘一下，他们纷纷盯着低头，生怕金刚佛子找他们的麻烦。
一炷香后，金刚佛子身上的黑气散去，怒骂一句：“该死。”
“给我搜查，整个佛门都不要放过，必须要找到他，找到那些混蛋。”
“他们肯定藏在佛门灵山之中，找到他们，杀光他们。”
他，顾不上那么多，必须要找到他们，杀死他们，不然，他金刚佛子会成为整个佛门的笑话，代价太大了，金刚佛子承受不住，他想要成为佛祖，想要取代灵心佛子，不太可能。
自己身边的人都动摇了，不能继续下去，必须要挽救他的名声，可不能再次被别人当猴耍。
“你们都给我去搜，刮地三尺也要找到他们，那些人肯定就在佛门周围，绝对不能够放过任何一个地方。”
金刚佛子咬牙切齿命令，这一次，他不再藏着掖着，也不想要继续顾忌太多，必须要雷霆出击，才能给敌致命一击，那些敌人，不值得他继续温柔对待。
“佛子，这么做，佛门灵山会陷入动荡，其他的那些弟子会反对的。”一名弟子走出来，提醒道。
“无需管那么多，出了事情，我担着，你们尽管去做，必须要找到那些混蛋。”金刚佛子黑着脸，摆摆手道：“此事最为重要，其他人有意见，就让他们继续保持着，凡是对抗我们的人，都是他们的人。”
“无论如何，都要找到他们，然后，杀死他们。“
“是。”
content_en:
There are many factions in Buddhism, and each faction represents its own interests. After all, it is difficult for outsiders to enter the core. No matter how much you pay and how well you do, you will never be able to enter the core. It is destined by nature and cannot be changed.
It has nothing to do with your natural strength. It is simply because you are not one of theirs. Anyone who joins later will not be able to get in touch with the core. Xenophobia is very serious. In Buddhism, the relationship between each other is also different. For example, the status of Vajra Buddha and Lotus Bodhisattva are different. They are much higher than the status of Qingming Bodhisattva. Even if Qingming Bodhisattva is higher in seniority and stronger, they still cannot enter the core.
Her position is very embarrassing. She works and does everything, but as a result, the benefits do not go to her. Everything she does becomes a wedding dress for others, adding credit to others, but she gets nothing.
The very cruel reality made her want to escape from them, Vajra Buddha and Sumeru Buddha. However, she had nowhere to escape before. It was impossible for the benevolent Buddha to accept her. Even if they accepted her, they would treat her as an outsider and deal with it casually. In other words, they just wanted to let her work without giving any benefits, so they still could not enter the core.
In that case, he may be abandoned at any time, so he might as well continue to stay. The same goes for the Yellow Eyebrow Buddha before, even more ruthless, and he can be cruel to his own people, but... this time is different. The Yellow Eyebrow Buddha in front of him is not the Yellow Eyebrow Buddha, but the Spiritual Heart Buddha.
The two are different. Although Lingxin Buddha has replaced everything of Yellow Eyebrow Buddha and acted in his identity, Qingming Bodhisattva can still see the difference in this person. Lingxin Buddha can be trusted, and he treats her very well. Looking at the pill in his hand and Lingxin Buddha's attitude towards her, it all proves that Lingxin Buddha is more worthy of following.
Qingming Bodhisattva left with many benefits, but these benefits were beyond the reach of Sumeru Buddha. She had not seen them for so many years. Could Qingming Bodhisattva not be moved? Can you not be moved?
Lingxin Buddha watched her leave with a smile on his face: "Vajra Buddha, Sumeru Buddha, you can't even look down on your own people, why should you fight me?"
"You guys throw away such an important talent like Qingming Bodhisattva, hahaha."
"Instead, we value those wastes. Waste is waste. No matter how we cultivate it, no matter how many resources we invest, the result will remain the same and cannot be changed."
"Qingming Bodhisattva is very smart and outstanding. What she lacks is an opportunity and some resources. I can give her all these. It depends on what she does?"
She has given many benefits and is full of sincerity. If Qingming Bodhisattva follows him, she can... get more opportunities and enter the core. Lingxin Buddha will train her as a core and let her enter the core. This is her sincerity.
Others can't give it, and it's also because Lingxin Buddha is short of people. The previous people were harmed by the Yellow Eyebrow Buddha. He needs to recall these people and train a group of his own people again. Others' people are, after all, other people's.
Only your own people are the most trustworthy.
"The turmoil in Buddhism began, and it started with Qingming Bodhisattva."
"Hopefully those people can live longer and not die so quickly."
"To cause more difficulties for Vajra Buddha and others, it would be best to kill a group of people around him and cause him heavy losses."
The eyes of the spiritual Buddha were shining, and the Buddha's light was restrained. He stared outside, not going out, not blocking, and not participating.
Just be an outsider and watch it all.
On the other side, Vajra Buddha is in dire straits.
I finally caught up with the enemy, only to find that... I had been tricked, leaving a trail of black energy on the spot, leaving nothing behind.
When they arrived, the black energy exploded directly at the moment of collision, and the poor Vajra Buddha was killed.Shrouded in black energy, others behind him were unable to react in time, and were subsequently enveloped in black energy. All this happened too fast.
They were unable to dodge and had no time to get out of the way. One by one they were enveloped by the black energy. Then, they stood there, one or two of their faces turned ugly. They were enveloped by the black energy. How many people would be corroded by the black energy? In the end, would they become enemies?
The people present were silent because they were afraid that Vajra Buddha would turn his hand against them. They knew very well the consequences of being contaminated with black energy, and would rather kill the wrong person than let them go.
Vajra Buddha clenched his fists, with veins all over his body exposed, and stared at the black energy in front of him. The dissipated black energy left a trace, but nothing else was left behind. Lord Kutu ran away long ago and left him a big gift.
In this confrontation, he failed, completely.
I thought I had found the enemy, could catch him, and then find the Black Lotus body and destroy the escaped Black Lotus body. Little did I know that everything was under the control of others. Lord Kutu was luring him away, deliberately doing it.
There were several Buddhist disciples on the other side. The fate of those disciples can be imagined. After receiving the news, Vajra Buddha's face became more and more gloomy and ugly. The people around him did not dare to breathe or take a breath. They all stared down, fearing that Vajra Buddha would cause trouble for them.
After burning the incense, the black energy from Vajra Buddha's body dissipated and he cursed angrily: "Damn it."
"Search for me. The entire Buddhist sect must not be spared. We must find him and find those bastards."
"They must be hiding in the Buddhist Spirit Mountain. Find them and kill them all."
He couldn't care about so much, he had to find them and kill them, otherwise, he, Vajra Buddha, would become a joke to the entire Buddhist sect. The price was too great, and Vajra Buddha could not bear it. It was impossible for him to become a Buddha and replace Lingxin Buddha.
The people around him are shaken and cannot continue. He must save his reputation, but he cannot be played like a monkey again.
"You all search for them for me, even if you scrape the ground to find them. Those people must be around the Buddhist gate, and we must not let go of any place."
Vajra Buddha gritted his teeth and ordered. This time, he no longer hid, nor did he want to continue to worry too much. He had to strike with thunder to give the enemy a fatal blow. Those enemies were not worthy of his continued gentle treatment.
"Buddhist disciple, if you do this, the Buddhist spiritual mountain will fall into turmoil, and the other disciples will oppose it." A disciple came out and reminded.
"You don't need to worry so much. If something happens, I'll take it. You just go ahead and find those bastards." Vajra Buddha said with a dark face and waved his hands: "This matter is the most important. If other people have opinions, let them continue to maintain it. Anyone who opposes us is theirs."
"No matter what, find them and kill them."
"Yes."
